tokens.name: aurora-green
tokens.usage: Energy, vitality, natural phenomenon. Primary actions, success states, highlights. Used as background on `.logo`, `nav a::after`, `.hero`; text on `nav a:hover, nav a:focus`, `.stat-change`, `.footer-section a:hover`; shadow/glow on `.hero`, `.stat-card:hover`, `input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus`. 1.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: northern-lights-purple
tokens.usage: Mystery, innovation, creativity. Secondary actions, premium features, accents. Used as background on `.logo`, `nav a::after`, `.hero`; shadow/glow on `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-secondary:hover`.

tokens.name: ice-blue
tokens.usage: Clarity, tranquility, vastness. Backgrounds, containers, subtle emphasis. Used as background on `body`, `thead`, `footer`; border on `header`, `.stat-card`, `.table-container`.

tokens.name: snow-white
tokens.usage: Purity, simplicity, space. Main background, content areas, breathing room. Used as background on `body`, `header`, `.hero::before`.

tokens.name: frost-gray
tokens.usage: Subtle depth without harshness.

tokens.name: glacier-blue
tokens.usage: Soft transitions. Used as background on `thead`.

tokens.name: deep-arctic
tokens.usage: Authority, depth, night sky. Used as text on `body`, `nav a`, `.stat-value`; background on `.hero`. 8.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: aurora-pink
tokens.usage: Rare accent for special moments. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
